inputKind: Original authored teaching model (no third-party source)
goal: Show how one lever chooses a different power path: structure, free-running gears, synchronizer engagement and the ratio of every forward gear.
requestedDepth: Whole gearbox to synchronizer keys and bearing balls
engineeringEvidence: Authored spec gearbox-spec-1: module 3 mm, one 81 mm centre distance, exact tooth ratios.
presentation: Slowed rotation for legibility; authored shift timing; editorial explosion offsets.
limitations: Original teaching model with authored dimensions; not a production gearbox or engineering CAD.
Straight-cut spur gears of one module for legibility; production gearboxes typically use helical forward gears.
Gear speeds follow ideal rigid tooth ratios. No load, friction, backlash, efficiency or contact stress is computed.
Synchronizer speed matching and dog alignment are authored on the timeline, not simulated friction or indexing.
Ball bearings are idealized pure rolling; needle bearings are plain display sleeves. Seals, oil, the clutch and the shift interlock are omitted.
